query: Which football team does Lewis Young's older brother, Ashley Young, play for?
ground_truth: Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team

pipeline_result.response: Ashley Young plays for Manchester United. His older brother, Lewis Young, plays for Crawley Town.
retrieved_context: Ashley Young: Ashley Simon Young (born 9 July 1985) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team.

Lewis Young: Lewis Jack Young (born 27 September 1989) is an English professional footballer who plays for Crawley Town.  He can play either as a striker, as a right winger or as, most recently, a right back.  He is the younger brother of Manchester United footballer Ashley Young.
